attempt_selection: Only predeclared attempt_index0 enters the fixed four-recipe comparison. Every extra/retry attempt is retained and charged separately; no best-of or replacement.
boundary: No generated/human ratings or model quality inferred. Declared identities/independence are not authenticated. Known-score means retain explicit expected denominators; paired intervals require all twelve openings/four recipes. Equal-recipe mean is an explicit descriptive mixture of one greedy and three sampled settings; strata are separate. Small-panel percentile uncertainty does not establish population improvement; caps and failures remain visible.
